Aircraft.Instructions:
Competitor By: BaconAircraft
AG1: Navigation Lights AG2: Door AG3: Speedbrake
Notes: This is a glorified bus with wings, expect it to fly like a glorified bus with wings. You'll need to use flaps and stabilizer trim to takeoff, or risk a nice warm campfire at the end of the runway.
Takeoff: Flaps to -30%, Trim to -100%. For the shortest takeoff, engage the parking brake while the engines spool up.
Landing: Flaps to -100%, Trim to -75%. On approach, watch your speed! Aim for 170mph/150kts/275kph - don't let it get too slow, because it is hard to recover once you do.
